name: Vortex Warp
description: Turbulent vortex warp: the swirl angle is perturbed by eight counter-rotating FFT-banded lobes, R/G/B are fetched at different rotation angles so the prism fringe follows the flow lines, and the previous frame is advected along the tangential direction for motion smear. Held pointer tightens the core; clicks emit bounded counter-rotating shock rings.

updatedParams.name: Vortex Strength
updatedParams.description: Rigid rotation gain at the core; bass adds up to +45%.

updatedParams.name: Radius
updatedParams.description: Vortex extent in aspect-corrected UV; holding the pointer tightens it.

updatedParams.name: Spiral Twist
updatedParams.description: Radius-dependent spiral term layered on the rigid rotation.

updatedParams.name: Turbulence
updatedParams.description: Gain on the FFT-banded azimuthal lobes (was declared but unread before Batch 56).
